title: The Quiet Productivity Method
author: Emma Caldwell
short: A calm, practical system for doing your best work without burning out.
description: The Quiet Productivity Method shows you how to plan your week, protect your focus and finish what matters, without endless to-do lists or late nights. Each chapter ends with a short exercise you can use the same day.

title: Personal Finance Made Simple
author: Daniel Brooks
short: Budgeting, saving and investing explained in plain English.
description: Personal Finance Made Simple walks you through building a budget you can keep, creating an emergency fund, paying down debt and starting to invest. No jargon, just clear steps and real-world examples.

title: Everyday Home Cooking
author: Sophie Turner
short: Forty simple, delicious recipes for busy weeknights.
description: Everyday Home Cooking collects forty reliable recipes that use simple ingredients and take thirty minutes or less. Includes a pantry checklist, a weekly meal planner and tips for cooking once and eating twice.

title: Mindful Mornings
author: Grace Harper
short: Start every day with clarity, energy and intention.
description: Mindful Mornings offers short routines for breathing, movement, journaling and planning that fit into fifteen minutes. Build a morning habit that sets a positive tone for the whole day.
chapters: The Power of the First Hour

title: Python in 30 Days
author: Michael Grant
short: Learn programming step by step with one short lesson per day.
description: Python in 30 Days takes complete beginners from their first line of code to small, useful programs. Every day has a focused lesson, worked examples and a mini project to practice what you learned.

title: The Art of Short Stories
author: Oliver Bennett
short: Craft memorable short fiction, from first idea to final draft.
description: The Art of Short Stories explains how to find ideas, build characters, write strong openings and endings, and revise with confidence. Includes writing prompts and annotated example stories.
